info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Support Tickets Create-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Creation API enables organizations to efficiently submit and manage support requests. It facilitates the creation of new support tickets by capturing essential information such as issue type, customer details, and urgency level. This API serves technology teams, customer support personnel, and automated systems needing to streamline their ticketing processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their customer service efficiency and responsiveness.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new support ticket, providing necessary details and any relevant attachments. It facilitates the tracking and resolution of issues reported by users.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating a new ticket. It must conform to the specified schema and contain all required fields to successfully create a ticket.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
